# sample published pool text for make_study tests (mirrors canon/pool-extra.txt layout)
SUBELEMENT E1 - COMMISSION RULES [2 Exam Questions - 2 Groups]
E1A Frequency privileges; signal frequency range; stations aboard ships or aircraft
E1A01 (D) [97.9(a)]
Which operator class conveys all available U.S. amateur operating privileges?
A. Technician
B. General
C. Advanced
D. Amateur Extra
~~
E1A02 (C) [97.313]
What is the maximum transmitting power an amateur station may use on 20 meters?
A. 200 watts PEP
B. 500 watts PEP
C. 1500 watts PEP
D. 5000 watts PEP
~~
E1B Station restrictions and special operations: restrictions on station location; RACES operations
E1B01 (B)
When must an amateur station transmit its call sign?
A. Every 5 minutes during a contact
B. At least every 10 minutes during and at the end of a contact
C. Once per hour while operating
D. Only at the beginning of a contact
~~
SUBELEMENT E2 - OPERATING PROCEDURES [1 Exam Question - 1 Group]
E2A Amateur radio in space: amateur satellites; orbital mechanics; frequencies and modes
E2A01 (A)
What is an amateur satellite?
A. A station in space operating in the amateur-satellite service
B. A radio that only receives weather broadcasts
C. An antenna with more than one element
D. A type of battery charger
~~
SUBELEMENT E5 - ELECTRICAL PRINCIPLES [1 Exam Question - 1 Group]
E5A Resonance and Q: characteristics of resonant circuits; series and parallel resonance
E5A01 (B)
What is the unit of electrical current?
A. Volt
B. Ampere
C. Ohm
D. Watt
~~
SUBELEMENT E9 - ANTENNAS AND TRANSMISSION LINES [1 Exam Question - 1 Group]
E9G The Smith chart
E9G06 (A)
On the Smith chart shown in Figure E9-3, what is the impedance at the center of the chart?
A. 50 + j0 ohms
B. 0 + j0 ohms
C. 75 + j50 ohms
D. Infinite impedance
~~
SUBELEMENT E0 - SAFETY - [1 exam question - 1 group]
E0A Safety: RF radiation hazards; hazardous materials; grounding
